hero.mobileDescription: August 11-May 27. Six early dismissals. Winter return January 5; spring return March 30. March 29 remains part of spring break.

editorialSummary.heading: Plan for the Monday at the end of spring break
paragraphs: The March calendar gives Collier families more time off than the Monday-Friday spring holiday alone would suggest. Students are out March 19 for teacher planning, followed by the March 22-29 spring break. March 29 is a Monday and remains part of that break. The scheduled return is Tuesday, March 30, after eleven consecutive days without classes. The third report card follows April 5.

Six early dismissals are spread across the year, including May 21 during graduation week and the May 27 final student day. December 18 ends the second quarter but is not marked as a shortened day. Pickup times need a school-level check: Mike Davis Elementary publishes an 11:50 a.m. early release, and Big Cypress lists the same time specifically for October 29. Those notices do not set a single dismissal time for every campus.

Families using School Age Childcare should check its own operating calendar. Some teacher planning days offer full-day care, and care is available during spring break, but SACC lists April 21 as closed even though students attend school and leave early that day. Graduation week runs May 17-21; confirm the ceremony assigned to your school rather than treating the whole week as a senior attendance schedule.

faqs.question: When does the 2026-2027 school year start and end?
faqs.answer: Students begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026 and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. The last student day has early dismissal. August 4 is the teacher start, and May 28 is teacher planning after regular student classes end.

faqs.question: Which six dates have early dismissal?
faqs.answer: The dates are August 26 and October 29, 2026, and February 2, April 21, May 21 and May 27, 2027. Students attend and leave early on all six dates. The December 18 quarter-end is not on this list.

faqs.question: What time should I pick up my child on an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: Check the school’s notice. Mike Davis Elementary’s 2026-2027 schedule gives 11:50 a.m. early release, and Big Cypress Elementary specifically lists 11:50 a.m. for October 29. Both are Eastern Time. The annual district PDF gives dates without a districtwide pickup time.

faqs.question: What are Mike Davis Elementary’s regular school hours?
faqs.answer: The published 2026-2027 schedule gives an 8:20 a.m. first bell, 8:25 a.m. late bell and 2:55 p.m. dismissal. Supervised arrival and breakfast begin at 7:45 a.m. Early-release dismissal is 11:50 a.m. These are Mike Davis Elementary’s times, not a schedule for every Collier school.

faqs.question: Do students attend on September 21?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 21, 2026 is a teacher professional-development day with no student classes. The calendar permits activities after sundown that day. The scheduled student return is Tuesday, September 22.

faqs.question: Does the September 11 sundown restriction cancel school?
faqs.answer: The calendar says no activities after sundown on September 11, 2026. It does not list a daytime student holiday or early dismissal. Middle and high schools also have an interim-period endpoint that day; that reporting milestone does not change the daytime schedule.

faqs.question: Is October 12 a day off for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, October 12, 2026 is teacher planning with no student classes. The scheduled return is Tuesday, October 13. The preceding October 9 quarter-end is not marked for early dismissal.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Collier County?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break: November 23-27, 2026. Thanksgiving Day is already inside that range. Including the surrounding weekends, students have November 21-29 off, with a scheduled return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: Do students return on January 4 after winter break?
faqs.answer: No. Winter break is December 21-31, 2026, followed by the January 1 holiday and the weekend. January 4 is a teacher planning day without students. The PDF explicitly returns students Tuesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Is December 18 an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: December 18, 2026 ends Quarter 2, but it is not marked as early dismissal. Winter break begins after that student day, with the named holiday starting Monday, December 21.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and is March 29 a school day?
faqs.answer: The printed spring break is March 22-29, 2027, so Monday, March 29 is still off. March 19 is a separate teacher planning day. Together with the weekends, students have March 19-29 off continuously, with a scheduled return Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: Which Monday holidays give students long weekends?
faqs.answer: Labor Day on September 7, 2026, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027 and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027 are student and teacher holidays. Classes are scheduled to resume the following Tuesday after each.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a student holiday?
faqs.answer: November 11, 2026 is not listed as a student holiday or an early-dismissal date on this calendar. The district web calendar’s school board meeting that day does not make it a student day off.

faqs.question: When do the four quarters end?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 9, 2026; Quarter 2 ends December 18; Quarter 3 ends March 18, 2027; and Quarter 4 ends May 27. Only May 27 is also marked for early dismissal among those four dates.

faqs.question: When do interim grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The dates are September 11 and November 6, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027. The September 11 entry applies only to middle and high schools. The other entries do not carry that restriction.

faqs.question: When are interim grades published?
faqs.answer: Middle and high school interims are published September 17, 2026. The later publication dates are November 12, 2026, February 9 and April 29, 2027. An interim-period end and an interim publication date are separate steps.

faqs.question: When are report cards published?
faqs.answer: Report cards are published October 19, 2026, January 11, April 5 and June 7, 2027. The final June 7 release follows the May 27 last class day; it is a reporting date, not another attendance day.

faqs.question: When are graduation ceremonies, and do seniors finish during graduation week?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar lists graduation week May 17-21, 2027. It does not assign each school a ceremony time or state a separate final attendance day for all seniors. Follow the high school’s ceremony, exam and checkout instructions. May 21 is also an early-dismissal day for students.

faqs.question: Is School Age Childcare open on planning days and during spring break?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 SACC calendar lists full-day care on September 21, October 12, January 4 and March 19, and during March 22-29 spring break. Published full-day hours are 6:30 a.m.-6:30 p.m. Confirm enrollment and site arrangements with SACC; these care hours do not mean regular classes are in session.

faqs.question: Is after-school care available on April 21?
faqs.answer: The district has early dismissal April 21, 2027, but the separate SACC calendar lists programs closed that day. Families using that service need another pickup or care arrangement. SACC’s opening time on other early-dismissal dates is not a districtwide school dismissal time.

faqs.question: How many student days are in the approved calendar?
faqs.answer: The PDF explicitly totals 180 student days. The 196 figure is for teachers. The four student quarters contain 42, 44, 51 and 43 days, which also add to 180.

faqs.question: Are any holidays designated as weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The approved PDF does not give a reserve-date list or make-up order. Use district weather announcements for any actual change. CCPS says updates are sent through official school and district channels, its website and official social accounts; keep Parent Portal contact details current.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar in another language?
faqs.answer: The district’s Academic & District Calendars page links the approved 2026-2027 PDF in English, Spanish and Creole. It also has the live district calendar. Use school notices and the district’s Weather Updates page for later operating changes.

editorialSummary.heading: The student year continues after Memorial Day
paragraphs: Collier County finishes this school year Thursday, June 1, with early dismissal. Memorial Day on May 29 is a holiday within the student year, followed by scheduled classes May 30-31. High school commencements take place May 24-26, and May 26 is also an early-dismissal day. The ceremony window does not identify a separate last attendance day for all seniors. Schools will provide the details families need for graduation.

There are two useful extended weekends to note. October 11 is off for students and teachers, and October 12 is a teacher planning day without students. That sequence gives students October 9-12 off, including the weekend. Later, the separately listed April 14 and April 17 dates form a four-day break across the weekend. The academic calendar supplies no holiday names for those two April dates.

Spring break is March 13-17, followed by the weekend and March 20 teacher planning. The scheduled return is Tuesday, March 21, with third-quarter report cards published March 27 and early dismissal March 29. In winter, the January 3 paid holiday and January 4 planning day delay the return until January 5. December 17 ends Quarter 2 and is not listed for early dismissal.

faqs.question: What are Collier County’s first and last student days for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Students start Wednesday, August 11, 2027 and finish Thursday, June 1, 2028. The final student day has early dismissal. June 2 teacher planning is after students finish.

faqs.question: Which dates have early dismissal in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The six dates are August 25 and November 4, 2027, and February 1, March 29, May 26 and June 1, 2028. Each is a shortened attendance day. December 17 is a quarter-end, with no early dismissal listed.

faqs.question: Does the annual calendar give early-release pickup times?
faqs.answer: It lists the dates but does not give a districtwide dismissal time. Check your school’s 2027-2028 schedule and transportation notices. School and childcare hours published for an earlier year do not establish the pickup time for this calendar.

faqs.question: Is September 22 a full student holiday?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, September 22, 2027 is teacher professional development with no student classes. It is separate from the August 25 early-dismissal day. Students are scheduled back Thursday, September 23.

faqs.question: Does the October 1 after-sundown rule cancel daytime classes?
faqs.answer: No daytime holiday or early dismissal is listed for October 1, 2027. The note says no CCPS events after sundown. Check school communications for how that restriction affects an evening activity; the annual PDF gives no sunset clock time.

faqs.question: Are students off on both October 11 and October 12?
faqs.answer: Yes. October 11, 2027 is off for students and teachers, and October 12 is a teacher planning day without students. With the weekend, students have October 9-12 off. The scheduled return is Wednesday, October 13.

faqs.question: When is the fall break over Thanksgiving?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs November 22-26, 2027. Including the weekends on either side, students are off November 20-28. The scheduled return is Monday, November 29. Thanksgiving Day is already part of that break.

faqs.question: When do students return after the Christmas and New Year holiday?
faqs.answer: Winter break is December 20-31, 2027. January 3, 2028 is a paid holiday with no student classes, and January 4 is teacher planning. The stated return is Wednesday, January 5.

faqs.question: Is December 17 shortened because Quarter 2 ends?
faqs.answer: December 17, 2027 is the second-quarter endpoint but is not listed for early dismissal. The winter holiday begins after that day, with the named break starting Monday, December 20.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and why is the return March 21?
faqs.answer: The named break is March 13-17, 2028. It is followed by the weekend and a March 20 teacher planning day without students. That gives ten consecutive days off, March 11-20, with a scheduled return Tuesday, March 21.

faqs.question: Are April 14 and April 17 separate days off?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists both dates as no school for students and teachers. The intervening weekend makes a continuous April 14-17 break, with a scheduled Tuesday, April 18 return. The PDF does not give the two dates specific holiday names.

faqs.question: Do students still attend after Memorial Day?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the published schedule. Memorial Day on Monday, May 29, 2028 is a holiday, followed by regular scheduled classes May 30-31 and the early-dismissal last day June 1. Graduation ceremonies the previous week do not end the district student year.

faqs.question: Which other Monday holidays are student days off?
faqs.answer: Labor Day on September 6, 2027, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 17, 2028 and Presidents Day on February 21 are student and teacher holidays. The scheduled return after each is Tuesday.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a no-school day in this calendar?
faqs.answer: November 11, 2027 is listed as an interim publication date, not a student holiday or early dismissal. The approved calendar does not give students a Veterans Day closure.

faqs.question: What are the quarter-end dates?
faqs.answer: The endpoints are October 8 and December 17, 2027, March 10, 2028 and June 1. The first three are not marked for early dismissal. June 1 combines Quarter 4 end, early dismissal and the final student day.

faqs.question: When do interim periods end, and when are grades published?
faqs.answer: Middle and high schools have a September 10, 2027 interim endpoint and September 16 publication. The later endpoint/publication pairs are November 5/11, February 4/10 and April 21/27. The later entries are not restricted to middle and high schools in the PDF.

faqs.question: When are report cards available?
faqs.answer: Report cards are published October 18, 2027, January 12 and March 27, 2028. Final report cards are available electronically June 12, after classes end June 1. The reporting date does not add another school day.

faqs.question: What is the 2028 graduation schedule?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar gives a May 24-26 high school commencement window. Schools will supply their own ceremony assignments and times. May 26 is also a student early-dismissal day; the window does not set a separate last attendance day for every senior.

faqs.question: How many school days does the approved calendar include?
faqs.answer: The final student column totals 180 days. The four quarter figures are 41, 43, 46 and 50, also totaling 180. The neighboring 196-day total is for teachers and should not be used as a student count.

faqs.question: Which dates might change for weather make-up?
faqs.answer: No reserve holiday or activation order is designated in the approved academic PDF. Watch official CCPS weather and school announcements for any later revision; do not assume that an existing holiday or early-dismissal day has already been converted.

faqs.question: Where is the official 2027-2028 PDF?
faqs.answer: The Academic & District Calendars page links the approved calendar in English, Spanish and Creole under future calendars. The English PDF prints Board approval on January 20, 2026. Check the same page and district announcements for later updates.
